title: Performance verifier ignored the explicit versioned campaign authority

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 3.2.5 and 3.2.3 packages on Factorio 2.1.13 after MIR3-TERM-0024
source_observation.fact: All ten C32 performance lanes completed and passed, but Test-MIRRuntimePerformanceEvidence reopened the obsolete root C24 campaign instead of the explicit 3.2.5-C32 authority passed to Invoke-MIRPerformanceQualification.

reproducer.expected: Producer and verifier bind the same explicit versioned campaign authority.
reproducer.observed: The producer emitted passed C32 evidence, then the verifier failed with 'Runtime performance evidence does not bind a coherent governed target-era campaign.'

calibration_recurrence.fact: The exact resumed 3.2.5 convergence campaign completed all governed performance lanes successfully, but the outer assurance executor revalidated the captured evidence without the active 3.2.5-C32 CampaignPath and fell back to the obsolete root 3.2.2 authority. The exact performance attempt therefore failed after successful evidence production.
